role: Enforces CANON A.21.3 hard-block validation checks on YAML skill package manifests before installation.
detail: SkillPackageValidator is a stateless gate that runs eight sequential hard-block checks against parsed YAML skill package dicts: (1) canon_provenance must equal TAUGHT_PROCEDURE, (2) all node_types must be in A.18 permitted whitelist, (3) no COMPUTES_TO edges (results never pre-loaded), (4) no IS_A/HAS_PROPERTY edges asserting semantic world facts (only SemanticEdgeType vocabulary nodes permitted), (5) packages declaring a new domain must have at least one cross-domain bridge, (6) all packages in requires: must be installed or in ANCHOR_LAYER_PACKAGES set, (7) no node/edge may explicitly declare confidence > 0.15 (bootstrap ceiling), (8) no node may carry sensor/guardian/inference provenance (only taught_procedure permitted). ValidationResult dataclass holds is_valid bool, errors list, package_id, and checks_passed tracking. All checks run synchronously; execution stops at first failure (no partial validation). No side effects: stateless, reads manifest dict and installed_packages set, writes nothing.
constants: _A18_PERMITTED_NODE_TYPES (frozenset of 14 types: ProceduralTemplate, ProcedureStep, WorkedExample, ConceptPrimitive, ValueNode, WordSenseNode, WordFormNode, SemanticEdgeType, LogicalAxiom, ActionProcedure, DefinitionNode, DomainRegistration, SkillPackage, ConversationContext)
gotchas: Check 4 semantic-fact detection correctly permits SemanticEdgeType vocabulary nodes (e.g., IS_A definition node) while blocking actual IS_A fact edges (A.18 earned-facts principle). Check 7 confidence ceiling only fires on nodes/edges that explicitly declare confidence field; omitted fields use installer defaults. Check 8 provenance searches multiple locations (provenance obj nested dict source, properties dict, top-level keys); normalizes to lowercase for comparison. All checks use fail-fast strategy (stop at first error); validation halts before returning partial results. Design assumes GraphPersistence backend queries SkillRegistry to populate installed_packages before validator runs (validator is pre-installation gate, not runtime guard). Phase 1.8-E1, Ticket T004, canonical refs CANON A.21.3, A.18, A.21.1, A.20.5.
